component.name: Cardmarket Price Updater
component.summary: Update card collection prices from Cardmarket in a spreadsheet

description.p: Reads a spreadsheet of Magic: The Gathering, Pokémon or Yu-Gi-Oh! cards identified by Cardmarket product ID, fetches current prices from Cardmarket's price guide, and writes them back into the sheet in GBP, EUR or USD.
Cross-platform Avalonia GUI, USD support, download retry/backoff, rotating backups, and a Linux/Flatpak build alongside Windows.
